nodes.label: Self-Learning Agentic RAG System
nodes.rationale: A staged guide covering RAG foundations, retrieval, validation, compression, workflow orchestration, self-learning, observability, and productionization.

nodes.label: Structured JSON Prompt Pattern
nodes.rationale: Constrain LLM tasks with role, exact JSON schema, examples, preservation rules, citations, and output-only instructions.

nodes.label: Validator String Parsing Bug
nodes.rationale: Disabling output repair must not disable JSON parsing; otherwise validators call dict methods on a raw string.

nodes.label: Unified Diagnostic Logging
nodes.rationale: LLM I/O should propagate through the root logger into the shared debug log instead of a dedicated file.

nodes.label: LangGraph Node-Service Boundary
nodes.rationale: Nodes belong to workflow structure and read or update state; services are reusable helper logic called by nodes.

nodes.label: Answer Pipeline Node Decomposition
nodes.rationale: Draft generation, answer-quality checking, and auto-distillation should be separate conditional graph nodes.

nodes.label: Global Async Query Lock
nodes.rationale: A process-wide lock held for the entire handler serializes otherwise concurrent API requests.

nodes.label: FIFO LLM Rate-Limit Gate
nodes.rationale: A FIFO gate, token-reset deadline, and adaptive cooldown coordinate calls, but SDK-internal retries can hold and bypass the intended control loop.

nodes.label: MongoDB-Backed Application Stores
nodes.rationale: Replace JSON and JSONL persistence with dedicated MongoDB store classes while retaining Chroma for vector storage.

nodes.label: Query Variant Pre-Filtering
nodes.rationale: Remove exact, normalized, previously failed, and embedding-similar variants before graph fan-out to avoid full redundant branches.

nodes.label: Evidence-Based Retrieval Tuning
nodes.rationale: Tune top-k and similarity thresholds using production score distributions, rank decay, and downstream validation rather than theoretical defaults.

nodes.label: Task-Specific Small-Model Routing
nodes.rationale: Keep user-facing generation on the existing Groq model and route high-volume structured judge tasks to smaller free local or alternative-provider models.

nodes.label: ASD Acronym Retrieval Ambiguity
nodes.rationale: The same acronym retrieves Autism Spectrum Disorder and Adjustable Speed Drive material, demonstrating semantic contamination in learned QA retrieval.

nodes.label: Continual Agent Harness
nodes.rationale: Long-horizon agents fail not only because of the model but because the surrounding harness must provide memory, planning, feedback, and recovery.

nodes.label: Pre-call Context Logging
nodes.rationale: Log characters, estimated input tokens, and configured output allowance before invocation so failed or stuck calls remain diagnosable.

nodes.label: Private LLM Observability
nodes.rationale: Prompts, retrieved chunks, outputs, and agent state should remain inside the local network when privacy is strict.

nodes.label: Guidance Constrained Generation
nodes.rationale: Constrained generation can guarantee schemas and reduce JSON parsing failures and retry loops in retrieve, compress, and judge stages.

nodes.label: ChromaDB Write Bottleneck
nodes.rationale: Frequent persistent collection.add calls can dominate ingestion time even when GPU embedding is fast.

nodes.label: Best-of-N Retrieval
nodes.rationale: Generate several query reformulations and use a judge to select the most relevant retrieved context.

nodes.label: Answer Grounding Judge False Positive
nodes.rationale: A retry generated an unsupported therapy comparison and the second judge incorrectly marked it grounded.

nodes.label: User Constraint and Quality Heuristic Conflict
nodes.norm_label: user constraint and quality heuristic conflict

nodes.label: Structured LLM Output Repair
nodes.rationale: Malformed LLM JSON should be recovered with json_repair and validated against project schemas with Pydantic.

nodes.label: Agentic RAG
nodes.rationale: Replace a fixed retrieve-then-answer pipeline with a tool-calling reasoning loop that can reformulate and retry retrieval.

nodes.label: Self-Learning RAG Loop
nodes.rationale: Persist good interactions, distill synthetic QA pairs, and retrieve them alongside source documents.

nodes.label: Thumbdown Failure Memory
nodes.rationale: Store bad answers, user feedback, attempted variants, and retrieved chunks, then warn future runs when the normalized query recurs.

nodes.label: Long-Context Stress Testing
nodes.rationale: Measure the practical context ceiling with realistic tool history and controlled irrelevant padding rather than relying on the advertised window.

nodes.label: Local-LLM Migration
nodes.rationale: Chat generation stays on local TGI while embeddings use the Hugging Face Inference router because the TGI proxy exposes no embeddings endpoint.

nodes.label: Python 3.12 Virtual Environment
nodes.rationale: Python 3.12 was selected over 3.14 for broader LangChain and LangSmith dependency compatibility.

nodes.label: Permanent Cross-Referenced Tracking IDs
nodes.rationale: Stable ADR, bug, research, and date identifiers connect project history without duplicating explanations.

nodes.label: Trace-Level LLM Workflow Debugging
nodes.rationale: Internal stage traces reveal which component causes latency that total request time alone cannot localize.
